title: Sound
subtitle: Production, Propagation, and Characteristics of Sound
subject: Science
author: Antigravity
learning_outcomes: Understand the production and propagation of sound.
Identify and calculate frequency, wavelength, and speed of sound.
Explain the concept of reflection of sound and echo.
Understand the applications of ultrasound and the structure of the human ear.

ai_context.learning_goal: Master the fundamental concepts of sound waves, their characteristics, and practical applications in the real world.
common_misconceptions: Sound can travel through a vacuum.
All waves travel at the same speed.
ai_context.tutor_hint: Always remind the student that sound needs a material medium to propagate.
